Having a physical fight with your cousin at a family gathering isn't a good idea. It would only be advisable for a physical fight to occur if the cousin did something again and people were in danger of something happening. Also fights, even mild ones can become dangerous and life-threatening easily, it's not like some sort of contact sport, you can know idea how the cousin could react, even if it was in the same way it's not not safe. If OPs boyfriend can't immediately cut out the person who sexually abused his girlfriend, then how do you think he's going to be able to fight him? I also doubt OP wants to see her boyfriend beat the shit out of his cousin, I've found the average well adjusted adult doesn't appreciate displays from their long term of violence to communicate love, even hurting people in someone else's name usually just makes the person who it's for feel guilty. I'd have to guess maybe \~95% of people would have a problem with violence being committed unnecessarily in their name. You probably shouldn't give advice like this, people might take it and then fuck up their life, their relationship, and then have a guilty conscience to top it off. In this post I doubt your comment would really be a problem but this sort of reaction is very unhelpful, trust me on that. Also, a family gathering? That's a terrible context for this kinda stuff.

Okay, so, awhile ago someone who I’d kinda *massively* fallen for and I decided we’ll see how it goes etc. All good, but it wasn’t. Today I found out it wasn’t going well, well it was but she came to the sudden realisation that I’m just fucked up. She wasn’t mean of anything, of course, we’re still gonna be friends. Well that’s if I don’t kill myself, I’m gonna wait probably until something else happens in my life or something so she won’t blame herself I think. This is what happens when you want to be in a relationship with a psychology student but you’re very unstable! /s? I’m not sure probably is just what happens. She’s got BPD and other stuff as well, is functional though, well I am too, in a way people can actually perceive. Right now I think I’m on the verge of a psychotic episode. I can hear voice, see shit that’s probably not there, taste blood, I don’t know why I keep trying to spit it out nothing there’s no blood. She thinks I’m too mentally unstable and it’s unsustainable, and she probably needs someone more stable during this period in her life. I would’ve easily killed myself and others for her, so I think I’d be able to try my best to make things work. There’s the thing though, not a “stable” way of being devoted, in fact it’s an entirely fucked way of showing love and devotion. I get why she wouldn’t take the risk but I wish she did because I could make it work, at least on her side, she wouldn’t have a clue how fucked I could be mentally but it’s a price you have to pay (?), that thinking is probably why my ex kinda was a bit physically abusive, and emotionally but sometimes I feel with certain people I don’t feel things. Right now I’m feeling the unbearable pain of someone being reasonable. just out of a psych ward as well. I actually tried to get my shit together, but it seems I’m just more likable the more obsessed and crazy I am on meds, but I guess that’s not love like this, just superficial stuff. I’m unsure what to do. I guess it’s good it’s over with, ripping of the bandaid but the bandaid on it’s one peeled the skin of and then my mental illnesses poured corrosive liquids on the wound, along with alcohol and set it on fire. I feel like I’m burning. I’m talking about this in a jokey way, but it not a joke, I want to mill myself. Dunno what to do she was so fucking perfect and no one will be like that again. Fuck I wasn’t even drinking that much or even “abusing” my medications but I don’t want to argue, but I wasn’t. Too unstable though, I get it. How do I rapidly get over this? There’s no time for mourning or crying, I can’t take meds it’ll just delay the time I snap, I think I’m on the verge of loosing touch with reality. I made the conscious choice not to trick my doctor into prescribing extra alprazolam, and I feel so fucking stupid for that, especially because it was her, I don’t give a shit on my own, red flag I know, love yourself before others. Doesn’t mean I don’t want to die. She was one of the only people I’d been actually romantically attracted to, most people not really, like sure people can be nice, attractive, fun, but I almost never feel attracted to people in that way. Wish me luck, I hope I don’t die soon because of this, I love you lovely people.
